questions.stem: A 35-year-old man presents to the clinic with a complaint of chronic pain in his left ear. On examination, the pain is localized around the concha and antitragus. The patient also reports occasional itching and discomfort deep inside the external ear canal. Which of the following nerves is most likely responsible for the pain in this region?

options.label: D
options.text: Auriculotemporal nerve (Mandibular branch of Trigeminal nerve)
